paper_3d_maze.description: Original 3D maze with poor localization, 100 runs, maximum macro action length 10 (Table 1).

success_rate.description: Fraction of evaluation episodes that reached the goal.

mean_total_reward.description: Average discounted return across evaluation episodes.

paper_hems.description: Original HEMS mission with evolving no-fly zones, 100 runs, maximum macro action length 15 (Table 2).

success_rate.description: Fraction of evaluation missions that completed successfully.

mean_total_reward.description: Average discounted mission return across evaluation episodes.

scaled_maze_online_planning.description: Accessible scaled maze substitute used by this reproduction. Raw success and reward rows retain paper Table 1 scale anchors from the original 3D maze; the primary metric is the paper-supported relational claim that PORPP beats the available baselines.

core_claim_supported.description: Relational claim check: 1 only when the candidate beats every available baseline on both success rate and reward.

success_rate.description: Fraction of scaled-maze episodes that reached the goal.

mean_total_reward.description: Average discounted return across scaled-maze episodes.

episodes.description: Number of valid episode artifacts scored for this method and slice.

valid_episode_rate.description: Fraction of selected artifact rows that contain the required episode fields with valid types.

unique_seed_rate.description: Fraction of selected valid episodes with distinct seeds, discouraging replayed or duplicated rows.

stderr_total_reward.description: Standard error of discounted return, used to expose noisy or brittle improvements.

success_gap_vs_refpol.description: Success-rate improvement over the heuristic-only reference policy.

reward_gap_vs_refpol.description: Mean-return improvement over the heuristic-only reference policy.
